title: Tianji Finale
next_chapter_hook: When that voice announced the identity of the Ultimate Chessmaster, the entire air in Tianji City froze—and Chen Ji knew that the true chess game had just begun.

text.content:
"Cang Yutian, do you think you're the one scheming here?"

That voice was like thunder across the ages, exploding in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. He stood atop the ruins of Tianji City, the surrounding air seemingly frozen into ice. No one noticed his abnormality—to everyone, he was still that humble Servant Disciple.

But the Tianji Record Fragment on his back was trembling violently.

dialogue.content:
(Inner monologue) Cang Yutian... Ultimate Chessmaster... So that's how it is.

Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, pressing all his shock deep into his heart. His fingers trembled slightly in his sleeve, but his expression remained calm as still water. Noted, this debt he recorded. Waiting so long—turns out the true opponent from the very beginning was that lofty existence.

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul violently fluctuated on the first page of the Tianji Record, that aged voice carrying a solemnity Chen Ji had never heard before: "Boy, you heard it. The Heavenly Eyes have noticed you. The Ultimate Chessmaster Cang Yutian is their agent in the mortal realm."

Chen Ji opened his eyes, his gaze sharp as a blade: "So all these years of my arrangements, he knew about them all along?"

dialogue.content:
"No," Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of depth, "He knew you were scheming, but he didn't know your chess moves. This— is the only difference between you and him."

A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, the coldness in his eyes intensifying. Only one? Then that was enough. Since the opponent didn't know his chess moves, he would make this chess game spectacular enough.

text.content:
The sky above Tianji City suddenly darkened.

Everyone looked up to see a massive shadow slowly emerging across the heavens. It was an eye—an eye spanning ten thousand miles, cold and merciless.

The Heavenly Eyes.

Chen Ji clenched his fists, his fingernails digging deep into his palms. This was his ultimate opponent, the Chess Player of the ancient chess game.

dialogue.content:
Those eyes slowly rotated, as if surveying all of humanity. Then it spoke.

"Twin of Fate, Fate Writer, Ultimate Chessmaster." That voice was like heavenly law, unbreakable. "The tripartite pattern is established today. The victor shall hold the ultimate power over this heaven and earth."

Chen Ji felt a wave of dizziness. Heavenly Fate was being consumed frantically—the Tianji Record was operating automatically, attempting to see through the flaws in this ultimate chess game.

text.content:
On the Tianji Record's page, a line of golden characters slowly appeared:

[Heavenly Fate: -35]
[Warning: Ultimate existence detected, analyzing enemy core location...]

Chen Ji's heart tightened. Ultimate existence, the Heavenly Eyes. The Tianji Record was attempting to find its weakness. Every vision burned his Heavenly Fate.

dialogue.content:
"Enough!" Mo Xiansheng's voice carried urgency, "Keep going like this and your Heavenly Fate will be depleted!"

Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly cutting off the Tianji Record's operation. His gaze fell upon the center of that eye in the heavens—where there was a faint point of light.

The core location, he saw it.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eyes' scrutiny made everyone terrified, yet Chen Ji, in this life-or-death moment, saw the key to the ultimate decisive battle. He had to make a choice:

choices.description: Taking advantage of the Heavenly Eyes just appearing and Cang Yutian not yet fully awakened, strike first and directly target the core location.
choices.visible_cost: Consume massive Heavenly Fate for Ultimate Foresight
choices.visible_reward: Seize the initiative and put the Ultimate Chessmaster on the defensive
choices.risk_hint: Hasty attack may expose one's strength, drawing the Heavenly Eyes' direct attention

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, his fingers secretly forming seals within his sleeve. The Tianji Record Fragment in his body trembled violently, that familiar power surging once more. Foresight—he would use foresight to see through the flaws in this ultimate chess game.

Heavenly Fate was burning.

[Heavenly Fate: -50]

A blurred image emerged in his Mental Sea: the core of the Heavenly Eyes lay in the chaos realm above the Nine Heavens. To reach there, one must cross three heavenly chasms...

choices.description: Stay put, let the other two factions probe the depths of the Heavenly Eyes first, then reap the渔翁之利.
choices.visible_reward: See the situation clearly before striking, a sure-hit attack
choices.risk_hint: May miss the optimal attack window, allowing Cang Yutian to complete preparations

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly stepped back, hiding himself among the crowd. His gaze swept across his surroundings, seeing the representatives of the Twin of Fate, seeing the various factions stirring with intent.

Let them go test the depths of the Heavenly Eyes first.

He sneered in his heart. So what if he's the Ultimate Chessmaster? Before absolute strength, all schemes and intrigues are jokes. And Chen Ji—his specialty was finding truth within jokes.

choices.description: Deliberately expose a trace of Tianji Record's aura to lure the Heavenly Eyes' attention, while secretly coordinating allies to form an encirclement.
choices.visible_cost: May draw the Heavenly Eyes' direct attack
choices.visible_reward: Grasp the initiative of the battlefield, letting the enemy follow his rhythm
choices.risk_hint: Requires precise control of exposure degree, one misstep means total defeat

text.content:
A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips as a crazy plan formed in his mind. He quietly released a trace of the Tianji Record's aura—weak enough to be nearly undetectable, yet sufficient for those Heavenly Eyes to notice him.

As expected, those eyes slowly turned toward his direction.

But Chen Ji was not flustered. Because at this very moment, he sensed two familiar auras rapidly approaching—the Demonic Path mist of Ye Qing, Su Qingyao's sword intent.

Their encirclement was already formed.

Above in the heavens, the Heavenly Eyes seemed to sense something. It stopped rotating, quietly staring in Chen Ji's direction.

That feeling was like being watched by an ancient beast from the depths of time, causing trembling from the very soul.

dialogue.content:
"Interesting."

That voice rang out again, carrying a playful tone.

"An ant dares to peer at heaven?"

Chen Ji felt an invisible force pressing down on him, his knees slightly bending as the true qi in his body frantically circulated, barely resisting this oppressive pressure.

He sneered in his heart. Ant? Fine, then let this ant bite this elephant to death.

text.content:
At this moment, a sword light shot into the sky.

Su Qingyao's figure appeared before Chen Ji, the sword in her hand radiating brilliant light, forcibly cutting off that oppressive pressure.

"Chen Ji is a person of the Tianqing Sect." Her voice was cold as frost, "If you want to touch him, first ask my sword."

Chen Ji gazed at her back, a complex emotion surging in his heart. This woman, once again stood before him.

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao didn't look back, but her voice clearly reached Chen Ji's ears: "Don't stand there foolishly, whatever you're planning, now is not the time."

Her sword intent formed a barrier before her, temporarily blocking the Heavenly Eyes' scrutiny.

A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips. Good, very good.

He said softly: "Senior Sister Su, today's matter, I have recorded it."

text.content:
At the same time, black mist spread quietly, shrouding Chen Ji and Su Qingyao.

Ye Qing's figure emerged from the void, her face carrying a playful smile: "Heavenly Eyes? Sounds impressive, but—in my Demonic Path mist, even it cannot see through the secrets here."

Chen Ji nodded. The tripartite power structure was initially formed.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, his gaze piercing through the Demonic Path mist toward those cold eyes above in the heavens.

"Cang Yutian." He softly念出 this name, a cold smile curling his lips, "You think controlling heaven means controlling everything?"

His voice was soft, but the sharpness within it made both Ye Qing and Su Qingyao shudder.

Was this man finally showing his true fangs?

choice.prompt: Within the Demonic Path mist, Chen Ji stood shoulder to shoulder with his two allies. He needed to make the next decision:

choices.text: Reveal Part of the Plan to Allies
choices.description: Share the enemy core location analyzed by the Tianji Record with Su Qingyao and Ye Qing, forming a true alliance of retribution.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the full support of two powerful allies
choices.risk_hint: If information leaks, it will give the Ultimate Chessmaster an opening

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji remained silent for a moment, then spoke: "The core of the Heavenly Eyes lies in the chaos realm of the Nine Heavens. To reach there, one must cross three heavenly chasms."

Su Qingyao and Ye Qing exchanged glances, shock flickering in both their eyes.

He actually saw through even this?

choices.text: Only Show Information About the Three Heavenly Chasms
choices.description: Only reveal the information about the three heavenly chasms foreseen by the Tianji Record, keeping the core location secret to maintain the advantage of information disparity.
choices.visible_cost: Allies may develop a sense of distrust
choices.visible_reward: Retain trump cards, grasp initiative at critical moments
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may sense he's hiding something

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly spoke: "I saw three heavenly chasms. The first, the Myriad Thunder Chasm; the second, the Heart Demon Chasm; the third..."

He deliberately paused, his gaze sweeping across his two allies: "The third, I haven't seen clearly yet."

This was a lie, but he said it without changing expression.

Su Qingyao's brow slightly furrowed, as if sensing something, but she said nothing more.

Above in the heavens, the Heavenly Eyes suddenly emitted a blinding light.

"Ants scheming?" that voice carried a faint mockery, "You think hiding in that layer of demonic mist can escape heaven's gaze?"

Ye Qing's expression slightly changed. Her Demonic Path mist was actually beginning to be eroded by an invisible force.

dialogue.content:
"Ultimate Chessmaster Cang Yutian." that voice continued, "His agent in the mortal realm. He has awakened."

Chen Ji's heart tightened. Cang Yutian—that name—was it finally going to appear on the stage?

At this moment, the Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently again, a line of golden characters appearing:

[Destiny Writer aura detected]
[Ultimate Chessmaster officially appears]
[Tripartite pattern established: Twin of Fate | Destiny Writer | Ultimate Chessmaster]

text.content:
The Demonic Path mist completely dissipated.

Chen Ji, Su Qingyao, Ye Qing were exposed beneath the heavens. And right before them, a figure slowly materialized.

It was a middle-aged man, his features dignified, his aura profound as an abyss. His eyes—were exactly the same as the Heavenly Eyes above in the heavens.

Cang Yutian. Ultimate Chessmaster.

He gazed at Chen Ji, a playful smile curling his lips: "Tianji Record's successor? I've been waiting for you for a long time."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji met his gaze, a smile likewise curling his lips: "Waiting for me for a long time? So the Ultimate Chessmaster is nothing more than this— even needing others to come find him before knowing who his opponent is."

A cold light flashed in Cang Yutian's eyes, but his smile grew deeper: "Sharp tongue. Interesting, very interesting."

He took a step forward, and heaven and earth trembled: "Then let me see, this Destiny Writer of yours—what right do you have to play chess with me?"

Chen Ji did not retreat, but instead took a step forward: "Then, Ultimate Chessmaster—make your move."

text.content:
The confrontation between the two Chessmasters plunged all of Tianji City into deathly silence.

Everyone waited, waiting for the first move in this ancient chess game spanning countless ages.

Yet in Chen Ji's heart was a冷静 of calculations. Heavenly Fate slowly drained away, the Tianji Record operated frantically. He would see through the opponent's chess moves, he would find that sole opportunity for victory in this ultimate game.

Cang Yutian, do you think you're the one scheming here?

This sentence, he would return to the other party sooner or later.
